layout: Three columns by two rows. Volume numbers follow the reading order of the rows within each sheet.
prompts:
Use case: illustration-story, production art for the existing Chinese children's 2D game 山海行记. Create a landscape orientation 1536×1024 FULL-BLEED CONTACT SHEET, exactly THREE EQUAL COLUMNS x TWO EQUAL ROWS (6 square panels). Uniform strict grid edges at 1/3, 2/3 and half height, no gaps, no borders, no vignette between panels, no words, numbers, icons or text. Every individual square is an independent rich close-range museum-quality handmade colored CLAY miniature diorama with sculpted tactile material, cinematic soft daylight, depth, jewel-toned muted natural pigments, mossy stone and a cohesive traditional Chinese mountain palette. Deliberate different framing, lighting and silhouettes, main visual centered inside each cell, tactile natural-history artistry for 10+ kids; curious and calm. Where an entry is specified as a close-up, let the image crop the creature to that body part rather than invent anatomy. Follow this exact tile order, left to right across each row.
TOP LEFT: In a cinnabar valley a magnificent chicken-shaped mythical Chinese phoenix on a rock, luminous five-color layered clay plumage, unmarked feathers, proud calm broadside composition. TOP MIDDLE: Close-up of the sunset-red clay slopes and golden ore of Tian Shan with a winding ascending path, fiery rim light; landscape study alone, no animal. TOP RIGHT: A small crow-shaped Jingwei, patterned head, WHITE bill and RED feet carrying ONE twig over an eastern storm-blue sea, profile on a grey coastal rock. BOTTOM LEFT: A little fantastical animal shaped like a rabbit with expressive owl-like eyes, a bird beak instead of a mouth and one slender serpentine tail, resting in shaded scrub, body low, fine clay fur. BOTTOM MIDDLE: Botany specimen on green hills, square angular green stem with tiny yellow flowers and red fruit amongst plentiful leaves, close-up. BOTTOM RIGHT: On a red river bank exactly THREE cypress-shaped trees, beaded pearl-like leaves glistening in pale sun against a russet valley.
